errors.text: The proposed Hf10Mo20Ta10Ti30Zr30 composition has a nominal VEC of exactly 4.5, contradicting the stated requirement that VEC be below 4.5 and triggering its own falsification criterion.

The hypothesis simultaneously requires a single-phase BCC alloy and nanoscale coherent BCC precipitates, without defining a distinguishable second phase or providing evidence that such precipitates form in this composition.

The baseline strength evidence concerns HfNbTaTiZr, but it is transferred to HfMoTaTiZr without justification; the stated baseline density and ductility also disagree substantially with the target baseline.
None of the cited evidence supports the predicted precipitate structure, 900–1000 MPa strength, or 15–20% tensile elongation for Hf10Mo20Ta10Ti30Zr30.
